stem: One source batch is divided across two dry-room racks. What is required for traceability?
choices: Only the first rack needs the source link
Both receiving identities/locations remain linked to the same source transformation with required quantities and event data
The source identity can be deleted once split
The racks can be combined in one unlabeled record
rationale: Both receiving identities/locations remain linked to the same source transformation with required quantities and event data. This preserves the Course 006 safety, postharvest, traceability, contamination-control, authority or record-quality principle being assessed.
